title: New Year and Naming
description: Given two sequences of strings s1..sn and t1..tm, and q queries with year y, output the concatenation s[(y−1) mod n] + t[(y−1) mod m] for each query.
input_format: First line: n m (1 ≤ n,m ≤ 20). Next line: n lowercase strings (length 1..10). Next line: m lowercase strings (length 1..10). Next line: q (1 ≤ q ≤ 2020). Next q lines: integer y (1 ≤ y ≤ 10^9).
output_format: Print q lines; each line is the concatenated name for the given y.
expected_approach: Modulo indexing on both sequences: s_idx=(y-1)%n, t_idx=(y-1)%m; concatenate s[s_idx] + t[t_idx].

test_cases.input:
3 4
a b c
d e f g
5
1
2
3
4
5
test_cases.explanation: Wrap around each list independently using modulo.
Both sequences have length 1; the result repeats.
Indexes cycle every 2 years for both sequences.
